integrity: Self-contained analytic proof plus executable supporting checks. No independent mathematical or publication-priority validation.
scientific_limitations: Two nonadaptive independent Gaussian-noisy point sensors, one per coordinate of an independent planar standard Brownian bridge; additive precision budget. No arbitrary linear-sensing, unequal costs, correlated noise or more-sensor theorem.
title: Optimal asynchronous scalar observations of Brownian-bridge Lévy area under a precision budget
